key_insight: Jet-RL enables stable on‑policy reinforcement learning using FP8 by unifying precision across training and rollout, removing the costly BF16↔FP8 transitions and preserving policy performance while greatly reducing compute and memory for rollouts.
problem_solved: Rollout generation dominates on‑policy RL training cost (>70% of time) and current workflows mix BF16 and FP8, incurring expensive conversions and instability; Jet‑RL removes this bottleneck by making FP8 practical and reliable for end‑to‑end on‑policy training.
method: Unified precision flow: use a consistent FP8 numerical path across rollout and training to eliminate frequent BF16↔FP8 conversions and alignment overhead.
Precision-aware numerics: combine FP8 kernels with calibrated dynamic range management, loss scaling, and optimizer adjustments to preserve stability for on‑policy updates.
Safety/fallback mechanisms: lightweight runtime checks and selective BF16 fallback for numerically sensitive ops to maintain performance parity with higher precision baselines.
impact: Practitioners can run on‑policy RL (including LLM fine‑tuning workflows) with substantially lower rollout compute and memory costs, enabling faster experiments and cheaper production training without sacrificing policy quality.
